description: This file defines the 'ModularBackgroundService' class, a background service for managing and executing background tasks within the OrchardCore modular framework. It handles tenant initialization, task scheduling, locking, pipeline execution, and error handling.

classes.name: ModularBackgroundService
classes.description: A background service that manages tenant-specific background tasks, including scheduling, locking, pipeline execution, and error handling within OrchardCore.

methods.name: ModularBackgroundService
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for the background service.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Main execution loop for the background service, handling tenant warmup, periodic task execution, and error handling.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Executes background tasks for each tenant, managing scope creation, locking, pipeline invocation, and task execution.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates the scheduling and state of background tasks based on tenant status and configuration changes.

methods.name: WaitAsync
methods.description: Handles delay between polling cycles, respecting cancellation tokens.

methods.name: GetRunningShells
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently active and warmed-up tenant shells.

methods.name: GetShellsToRun
methods.description: Determines which shells (tenants) should have background tasks run based on scheduler readiness.

methods.name: GetShellsToUpdate
methods.description: Identifies shells that need their background task schedules updated or terminated.

methods.name: GetSchedulersToRun
methods.description: Fetches schedulers associated with a specific tenant that are ready to run tasks.

methods.name: UpdateSchedulers
methods.description: Updates the state of schedulers for specified tenants based on provided actions.

methods.name: CleanSchedulers
methods.description: Removes schedulers that are no longer valid or associated with current tasks.

methods.name: SetBaseUrl
methods.description: Configures the HttpContext request URL components based on a tenant’s base URL.
